changes.title: Bounded shared-memory broadcast waits
changes.note: The stacked #68441, #68444 and #68445 replayed onto main d1ad1088bc: lost wake-up fix, bounded WFET/WAITPKG spin waits, and opt-in adaptive spin time. #68445 lists all three commits.

changes.title: b12x GB10 integration ported from local-inference-lab karmic-kraken
changes.note: One commit carries the fork's b12x path onto main: V2 runner, worker and engine-core preparation hooks; b12x paged attention, noncausal and GDN backends; Qwen4Exp b12x QSA, PLE, hyperconnection and MTP; PCIe/RoCE all-reduce; row-cache prefetch bridge and Prometheus relay; and upstream #65233, #65240 (MXFP4 CSF experts) and #67236 (NVFP4 draft lm_head on SM121) folded in; the follow-up entry below replaces #65240's host-side scale encoder. Dropped: recurrent boundary checkpoints, DCP-replicated hooks, adaptive-verification cost profiling, the b12x load format and the fork's ParallelLMHead quantization API.

changes.title: DeepSeek V4.1 Engram tables served from checkpoint files
changes.note: Extends main's Qwen4Exp engram-config disk_offload to DeepSeek V4.1: rows are read with preadv before graph replay, so the ~196 GiB of FP8 Engram rows take no device or pinned host memory on GB10.

changes.title: b12x call sites moved to local-inference-lab FlashInfer APIs
changes.note: MoE compressed scales use b12x online CSF compression (WeightPlanConstraints(scale_compression="csf")) instead of the CsfScalePlanes encoder local-inference-lab removed, and the scale swizzle is read from b12x._lib.intrinsics.reference.

changes.title: Qwen4Exp b12x modules import their config from transformers
changes.note: Fixes an import break in the b12x Qwen QSA, PLE and indexer modules after the fork's config shim was removed; MTP index sharing is read from the draft model config, where main's speculative-config plumbing sets it (default off).

changes.title: Request-boundary recurrent checkpoints for Qwen3.8-Flash-Next
changes.note: Ports local-inference-lab's boundary checkpoint cache, admission, endpoint reservations, capture/restore and KV connector hooks onto main, so the LMCache recurrent checkpoint connector resumes follow-up turns. Checkpoint keys cover only tokens below the endpoint under main's hash lookahead. Out of scope: GLM-5-Next, Kimi-K3/KDA, DFlash replay, DCP, LoRA and the fork's prefill-policy scheduler. Also fixes b12x profiling/warm-up hooks running without b12x and an env leak in a carried test.

changes.title: GB10 decode context parallelism for DeepSeek V4.1
changes.note: Ports local-inference-lab/vllm#764 to SM12x packed sparse attention and adds legacy GEMM warmup coverage for DSpark adaptive verification. DCP4 shards compressed KV and optionally the FP8 index, while keeping sliding-window KV and compressor state replicated.

changes.title: Rewrite flash_attn.cute imports to vllm.vllm_flash_attn.cute
changes.note: Packaging repair for this builder's symlink install path, which skips the import rewrite the upstream CMake copy performs. It carries no upstream change.

changes.title: GB10 DSV4.1 decode split policy and NVFP4 CSF scale defaults
changes.note: The two GB10-specific tips of local-inference-lab/flashinfer's karmic-kraken GB10 line, replayed clean onto main 1d76585b1: three DSV4.1 decode splits on the 48-SM GB10 (mla/kernel.py) and CSF scale defaults on GB10 for the measured NVFP4 contract (fused_moe/_tuning.py).

changes.title: C S3-FIFO host row cache for disk PLE/Engram tables
changes.note: The twelve row-cache commits developed under local-inference-lab/flashinfer#44, replayed clean onto main 1d76585b1: the row-cache core, the caller-gated DiskTable.prefetch and host row-id helpers, and the prefetch telemetry commits. The upstream pull request later grew beyond these twelve; the lock carries exactly the audited set.

changes.title: SM12x packed sparse attention partial outputs
changes.note: Ports the log-sum-exp output contract from local-inference-lab/b12x#374 to FlashInfer's existing packed sparse attention API.
